conditional_fit: If independently verified feasible: minimize original J65 mean(rE^2)/.1^2+mean(rF^2)/.5^2 subject to rho=1 limits and original bounds. Strict convex objective/full rank provides deterministic unique selection; no regularization. Do not tighten/widen physical gates for numerical tolerance.
diagnosis: SVD of actual weighted scaled matrices; omitted-block/failure overlaps, bound recurrence, physical weak-direction and predicted force sensitivity. No validation observations.
failure_handling: Preserve each solve/status/state and exception; no inaccurate/incomplete status is infeasibility. Independent original-unit witness can establish feasibility. Numerical lower bounds must include checked dual-cone/support residual error. No replacement bootstrap draws.
geometry_only: If robustness fails, rank a bounded existing J63 graph-controlled candidate pool against measured weak directions; exclude all existing training and reserved validation by graph-aware proper alignment. At most4 proposals; no execution.

inherited_fit.acceptance: Same frozen energy/force/max gates on untouched validation plus predictive uncertainty; method-specific research only, never automatic assignment.
inherited_fit.candidate_activation: Full matching primary+joints, numerical gates, rank59/condition<=10000, solver success, no active bound, training thresholds and uncertainty all pass before untouched validation QM. A failed historical complete-basis gate alone never blocks this method-specific trial.
inherited_fit.condition_scope: Actual weighted59column matrix including offset; 10000 is an experiment identifiability screen, not prior987 geometry-only result or a physical certificate.
inherited_fit.curvature_constraints: Diagnostics only; selected-protocol baseline estimates not QZVP. No duplicate gradient-derived observations in objective.
inherited_fit.objective: mean((E_QM-E_fixed-Ap-offset)^2)/0.1^2 + mean(Cartesian_force_residual^2)/0.5^2; all81 components, one offset on training only
inherited_fit.offset: one unbounded additive training intercept in energy only; frozen unchanged on validation; subtract center electronic energy before kcal conversion for precision
inherited_fit.optimizer: scipy.optimize.lsq_linear TRF bounded linear least squares, column-scaled including intercept, tolerance1e-12,maxiter1000; no regularization

uncertainty.interval: 2.5/97.5percentiles only on explicitly eligible bootstrap replicates; retain every rank/conditioning/bound failure, no replacement resampling; failed fraction blocks eligibility. Absolute intervals for all coefficients incl near zero, covariance/correlations and prediction spread; limited small-block/model-discrepancy uncertainty, no physical confidence claim.
uncertainty.unit: whole training configuration/path blocks; all signs/steps of each primary path travel together; each joint and center separate blocks

problem: 58 unchanged physical variables plus one global energy-only intercept; r=MM-QM. Minimize rho>=0 under original bounds, ||rE||<=.1sqrt(N)rho, |rEi|<=.3rho, ||rF||<=.5sqrt(3NA)rho, ||rFij||<=2rho.

reconstruction_tolerance.native_replay: exact original J65 replay in a relocated directory

reserved_validation: all3 remain untouched in this phase regardless of outcome; zero new QM

resources.scratch: external temporary reconstruction only; no native engine invoked

scaling: Column norms of actual J65 weighted matrix including offset; z=norm*p. Each residual cone divided by its frozen physical threshold; bound inequalities divided by original bound width. Recompute scaling for each exact bootstrap sample.

solvers.cross_check: SCS independent backend, max_iters100000,time_limit120s,eps_abs/rel1e-7; same declared physical problem
solvers.diagnostic: If needed: repeat rho with bounds removed, and force-only rho with original finite bounds for a support-function dual lower bound. No unrestricted result is a candidate. Original-bound interior margin1e-6 tested separately when feasible.

uncertainty: Exact 64 retained J65 sampled_blocks, no resampling/replacement. For each draw solve rho then conditional LS if feasible. All four constraints apply to sampled training rows with multiplicities. Evaluate original22 predictions separately. Eligibility additionally rank59,condition<=10000,no bound activity,solver success,physical verification. Inherit80% and prediction spread limits. Survivor-only intervals explicitly conditional; retain all failures.
